description: One match by its TheSportsDB event id: final and half-time score, competition, season, round, venue, date and kickoff time, and the goal detail strings where the source carries them. Use for settling a match-level question (who won, what was the half-time score) after finding the event id with events_by_day, team_events_last or team_events_next.

_apiKey.description: Optional TheSportsDB key. The free tier serves this tool; a supporter key raises the rate limit.
